page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.16xlarge is a high-frequency general-purpose instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. With a 1:1 mapping of vCPUs to physical cores, this instance provides dedicated, non-shared compute resources, ensuring consistent performance without virtualization-induced jitter.

The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating reliable data transfer rates for multi-tier architectures.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high clock speed make this instance suitable for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. It is well-suited for enterprise applications, medium-to-large databases, web serving, and continuous integration pipelines where consistent execution times are critical.
